usta-1213102.name: Künefe
usta-1213102.description: A Hafız Mustafa 1864 creation combining crisp kadayif and cheese.
usta-1213102.ingredients: water, wheat flour, sugar, pistachios, cheese, vegetable oil, lemon juice.
usta-1213102.allergenInfo: Gluten (wheat), milk and dairy products, pistachios. May contain traces of walnuts because products containing walnuts are made on the same production line.
usta-1213102.servingSuggestion: Serve künefe hot to preserve the stretchy cheese and crisp kadayif. If desired, garnish with pistachios and serve with clotted cream or plain ice cream.
usta-1213102.storage:
For the best flavour, enjoy your product at room temperature.

You may also gently warm it in the oven before serving.
usta-1213102.longTermStorage:
You can store your products in the freezer at -18 °C for up to 30 days.

For the best flavour, thaw at +4 °C for 2 hours, then allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving.  Thawing directly at room temperature may cause dryness and a loss of crispness.

Do not refreeze thawed products.
